resources.string: Enables Glyph Matrix Toy Compat to detect presses of the Essential Key so you can control Glyph Toys: press once for a Glyph Touch action, twice to switch to the next toy, three times to return to the background toy. The service observes hardware key presses and Essential Space window events (to dismiss it when the system still reacts to a captured press); it never reads screen content.
Glyph Toys, cycled with the Essential Key

Glyph Matrix Toy Compat uses an accessibility service to detect presses of your phone’s Essential Key, including on the lock screen and Always-On Display. This is the only way a normal app can react to that key.

What the service does:
• Listens for Essential Key presses and consumes them so Essential Space does not open
• Single press: Glyph Touch action on the current toy
• Double press: switch to the next toy
• Triple press: return to the background toy

What the service does NOT do:
• It cannot and does not read your screen content
• It does not collect or transmit any data

On the next screen, enable “Glyph Matrix Toy Compat” under Downloaded apps.
GMTC %1$s is out — tap to open the download page.
Version %1$s installed — tap to check now (also checked daily)
Off — tap to enable in Accessibility settings
Select “Glyph Matrix Toy Compat” in Glyph settings so toys keep running on AOD (tap to open)

Hand the Essential Key over to Glyph Matrix Toy Compat (do NOT disable the Essential Space or Essential Recorder apps):
1. Settings → Intelligence Toolkit → Essential Key Settings → enable “Activate with single tap before use”.
2. Settings → Intelligence Toolkit → Essential Voice → disable “Activate via Essential Key”.
This stops the system from acting on the key directly; if a pop-up still slips through, Glyph Matrix Toy Compat dismisses it automatically.
If you sideloaded this app (not via adb), you may need to allow “restricted settings” from App info before the accessibility service can be enabled.
This device has no Glyph Matrix — rendering is disabled. (Phone (3) or Phone (4a) Pro required.)
When on, all Essential Key presses control Glyph Toys. When off, the key behaves normally.
Double-press opens a blinking on-glyph selector; single-press cycles toys, and the shown toy is set automatically after a few seconds. Single-press still triggers toy actions outside the menu.
Drag the handle to change the cycle order
Only show background for 30 s after a shake
